## August 2025 Newsletter

Posted on September 16, 2025 by Elizabeth Potter

Learn about al our summer happenings in our August 2025 Newsletter. – we tagged along during a VA Surge event to help house Veterans, visited The Campus emergency shelter program in Berkeley, and caught up with some volunteers at the Hope Center. Click to read more!

Posted in What's New, Newsletters
